_comment: jobfill design system, established 2026-07-25 via a greenfield /design run. Direction: catalogue-index. The dashboard is a single hand-written HTML file with an inline <style> block and vanilla JS, served by helper/server.ts on 127.0.0.1:7877. No framework, no build step, no npm UI dependency - a locked project decision.
_stackNote: Not one of the skill's standard enum values. Means: a single .html file, one inline <style> block, CSS custom properties for tokens, vanilla JS for behaviour. NO React, NO JSX, NO Tailwind, NO CSS-in-JS, NO build step, NO npm UI package. Variants are standalone .html files, not .tsx components.
_iconNote: There is no icon package and adding one would violate the no-dependencies rule. Hand-authored inline SVG is therefore EXPLICITLY ALLOWED for this project, overriding the skill's default 'no bespoke SVG' floor. Emoji as icons remain banned.

constraints._motionNote: Static posture: chrome + one functional disclosure + one functional countdown. No entrance choreography, no scroll-linked motion. These two keyframes are the canonical list - do not invent others.
constraints._typefaceNote: JetBrains Mono (machine facts) + IBM Plex Sans (human prose), self-hosted at helper/fonts/*.woff2. NO CDN, NO Google Fonts - the helper is localhost-only and must render identically offline.

_primitivesNote: No shared component primitives exist - the file is monolithic. Variants build their own, scoped to the variant file.
_referenceNote: catalogue-index is the DESIGN REFERENCE, not yet the live dashboard: it carries inline mock data and zero fetch calls, while helper/dashboard.html talks to 21 endpoints. Future /design runs in this project must rhyme with the reference; adopting it into the live dashboard is a separate implementation task (see DESIGN.md Adoption).
